name: 1990 US Census surnames
reason: lastnames.json is the 1990 Census surname list; the package carries no notice for it, and its source asks for a credit (010 research.md §2)

name: EFF Large Wordlist for Passphrases
reason: diceware.json is the EFF Large Wordlist; CC BY 4.0 requires this attribution and the package carries none (010 research.md §2)

name: Microsoft WebView2 loader
reason: webview2-com-sys links Microsoft's WebView2LoaderStatic.lib; no dependency tool lists a prebuilt library (010 research.md §3)

name: Moby Word Lists names
reason: firstnames.json is Moby's names-f.txt by way of random-name (MIT); the package carries neither notice (010 research.md §2)

name: OpenSSL
reason: the Windows build links vcpkg's static OpenSSL 3 into SQLCipher; the version is read from the build's headers (010 research.md §7)

name: OpenSubtitles 2024 word frequencies
reason: commonWords.json is derived from OpenSubtitles 2024; ODC-BY is allowed for this data only, with the package's own notices (010 research.md §2)

name: SQLCipher
reason: libsqlite3-sys compiles the SQLCipher source it carries into the program; the crate's license (MIT) doesn't cover it (010 research.md §1, §7)

name: SQLite
reason: SQLCipher's amalgamation holds SQLite, which is in the public domain; its notice is the blessing in the source (010 research.md §1, §7)

name: Ten million passwords
reason: passwords.json is counted from Mark Burnett's public-domain data set; the package carries no acknowledgement (010 research.md §2)
